newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Trading succumbs to weekend calm.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Trading succumbs to weekend calm.

text.p: Traders said after-hours activity was nonexistent on Friday because trading in key stocks was halted with the weekend fast approaching.
Before the markets closed, MCI Communications Corp and British Telecommunications Plc confirmed they were discussing a possible merger valued at about $22 billion.
MCI shares climbed 5-1/8 to 30-1/4 before trading was halted. BT's American depositary receipts shed 2-1/8 to 55-1/2.

The New York Stock Exchange said volume in its session one was 490,600 shares compared with 36,200 shares on Thursday. Session two volume was 1,235,700 shares compared with 5,644,200 shares on Thursday.
The American Stock Exchange said there was no after-hours activity.
